title: Welcome
text_standard: Open a bank account from your phone. First, choose how the app looks for you.
text_simple: Open an account on your phone. First, set up the app.

title: How would you like us to help?
text_standard: Choose your language and how the app looks. You can change this at any time.
text_simple: Pick your language and what helps you. You can change it later.

title: Sign up
text_standard: Choose how you would like to open your account.
text_simple: How do you want to open your account?

title: Check you're eligible
text_standard: Confirm your passport country and that you are 18 or older.
text_simple: Check if you can open an account with this app.
verified_info: Remote account opening with an e-passport is for applicants aged 18 and above with a biometric passport from Hong Kong, Malaysia, Indonesia or Mainland China.
suggested_questions: How do I know if my passport is biometric? | What can I do if my passport isn't on the list?

title: Get ready
text_standard: Have your biometric passport, national ID and an NFC-capable phone ready before you continue.
text_simple: Get these 3 things ready: your passport, your ID card and your phone.
verified_info: You need a biometric passport, your national ID card, and a phone that can read NFC chips. A biometric passport has a small chip symbol on its cover.
suggested_questions: What is NFC? | How do I check if my phone has NFC?

title: Scan your passport chip
text_standard: Hold your phone against your passport so the app can read its chip using NFC.
text_simple: Put your phone on your passport and keep still.
verified_info: The app reads the chip inside your passport using NFC. Hold your phone flat against the passport and keep both still until the scan finishes. Removing a thick phone case can help.
suggested_questions: Why won't my passport scan? | Where is the chip on my passport? | How do I know if my phone has NFC?

title: Verify it's you
text_standard: Take a photo of your national ID and complete a face check.
text_simple: Take a photo of your ID card. Then look at the camera.
verified_info: The app checks that you are the passport holder and checks your national ID. In this prototype, verification is simulated and no real biometric data is collected.
suggested_questions: Why couldn't it read my ID? | What happens with my face photo?

title: Supporting documents
text_standard: Upload your qualifying supporting documents within the required timeframe.
text_simple: Upload the documents we ask for.
verified_info: You need to provide qualifying supporting documents within the required timeframe. The accepted documents are listed on this screen.
suggested_questions: Which documents are accepted? | How long do I have to upload them? | Why was my file rejected?

title: Review and submit
text_standard: Review your details and declarations, then submit your application.
text_simple: Check everything, then send your application.
verified_info: Check your details before you submit. After OCBC receives your supporting documents, it may take up to 21 working days to tell you whether your account has been opened.
suggested_questions: What happens after I submit? | How long until my account is ready?

title: What happens next
text_standard: Your application has been submitted. We will notify you once it has been reviewed.
text_simple: Your application is sent. We will tell you when it is ready.
verified_info: OCBC may take up to 21 working days after receiving your supporting documents to confirm your account. You may need to complete an initial deposit or other follow-up steps.
suggested_questions: What do I need to do next? | When will I hear back?
